title: docs: refresh Divine org profile README
body:
## Summary

Updates the org profile README to reflect current Divine branding, architecture, and active repositories.

## What changed

- Replaced outdated diVine naming with Divine
- Updated repo map to current core services and apps
- Added explicit deprecation note:
  - divine-cdn-worker is deprecated and replaced by divine-blossom
- Removed stale/obsolete architecture wording and tightened contribution guidance

## Why

The current org README was out of date and could mislead contributors (and LLM-assisted workflows) about active repos and architecture direction.

title: feat(actions): add reusable mergeability check
body:
## Summary
- add a reusable workflow that checks pull request mergeability through the GitHub API
- poll briefly while GitHub computes mergeability so the check is stable on fresh PR updates
- fail with a clear message when a PR cannot be cleanly merged into its base branch

## Verification
- ruby -e "require 'yaml'; YAML.load_file('.github/workflows/mergeability_check.yml'); puts 'yaml-ok'"
- gh pr view 2159 --repo divinevideo/divine-mobile --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus
